faqs.question: How do I log into the KNEC portal?
faqs.answer: Visit https://qms.knec.ac.ke or the specific exam portal and use your registered institutional or candidate credentials.

faqs.question: What is the official KNEC helpline?
faqs.answer: You can reach KNEC support at 0800 724 900 or via email at info@knec.ac.ke.
